title: MCX Copper gains 1.00% to ₹1379.50/kg as industrial demand signals lift complex
summary: The mechanism is demand-side repricing. Copper's 1.00% advance reflects a synchronised industrial activity signal — when crude rises 2.68% simultaneously, markets are pricing stronger energy consumption alongside base metal demand, historically a coordinated manufacturing-expansion read rather than isolated speculation.

title: Crude surges 2.68% to ₹8970/bbl as risk-on tide lifts entire commodity complex
summary: The mechanism here is a simultaneous copper-crude advance — copper +1.0% signalling industrial demand recovery while crude +2.68% reflects the same risk-appetite rotation. When both move together, it historically indicates broad macro positioning rather than commodity-specific supply news.
